She knows the shortest number of daylight hours, shortest day, is on 21 December.
She knows the longest number of daylight hours, longest day, is on 21 June.
She collects data for the sunrise and sunset times on the 21st day of every month.
She works out the length of daylight in hours and minutes and converts it to a time in hours correct to
1 decimal place.
